question: Do clinically intended externally published diffusion-malignancy decision thresholds have a new useful case-linked EMC overlap/error pattern beyond already established myxoid-tumor exceptions and already published same EMC comparisons?
work_split: Owner authenticates complete EMC conditions and3named primaries; reviewer independently selects/tests primary external threshold applicability and prior-art/value, reusing owner caches. No duplicate full-source downloads.
before_values: No case ADC measurements or numerical EMC outcomes inspected. Read external decision-rule thresholds and methods/prior-art only; do not infer relevant EMC values from figure/images or numerical tables. If a discovered comparator includes EMC, flag eligibility and defer its case values to a frozen owner plan.
threshold_choice_rule: One primary clinical decision rule chosen for explicit intended benign-vs-malignant soft-tissue population, numerical measurement definition and acquisition/ROI compatibility, not cutoff producing desired EMC exception. A paper-derived ROC point is not a universal routine standard; myxoid exclusion or author-stated exception can defeat intended applicability. Do not invent a post hoc highADC threshold or call highADC alone a real benign clinical diagnosis.
conditional_statistic_contract: Only if source, novelty and assay applicability survive, owner must freeze one exact externally sourced threshold plus donor-level measure and all eligible EMC/myxoid control conditions before values. Descriptive fraction above/below rule with exact donor-denominator uncertainty may assess rule behavior; it does not estimate actual missed diagnosis, clinical harm, population specificity or management change without those measurements. No pooled ROI-as-donor, incompatible b-value/mean-min-ADC or retrospective matched-selection rescue.
fixed_comparator_question: Native pretreatment myxoid liposarcoma, myxofibrosarcoma and low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma observations from authenticated complete relevant source cohorts; preserve eligibility/no-linkednumericdata/pending separately and full EMC coverage. Non-EMC selection must be source/prior-art justified before case outcomes.
strongest_alternatives: Known general myxoid extracellular water behavior already invalidates a broad all-soft-tissue ADC cutoff
ADC measures b-value/ROI/cellularity/site/grade/therapy and acquisition differences, rather than new specific EMC physiology
HighADC does not cause a benign radiological interpretation when morphology/contrast/location already imply malignancy
Duplicate cases, aggregate-only values, min-versus-mean ADC or multipleROIs inflate precision or prevent individual threshold evaluation
defeat: Primary prior art already states/tests same consequential EMC or myxoid threshold contrast
No clinically intended applicable external decision rule, or myxoid tumors excluded from rule source
No authentic case-linked comparably acquired numericADC/units/ROI donor mapping for all relevant EMC conditions
No independent applicable clinical phenotype replication or useful next measurement beyond known myxoid caution
decision_options: No-go numerical stage source-specific and claim-specific with incomplete coverage pending; or one bounded frozen discriminating rule evaluation if assay validity AND new practical scientific value survive. No manuscript/paper rescue.
restrictions: Quiet API/files/PDF native text only; NYUI ban until14UTC. No images/digitization/DICOM/UI/headless; restricted FAP/glycan/HLA/structural genomic bypass, paid/private requests/outreach/pub/manuscript/rootwrites/push. Original IG freezes immutable. Codex author and committer.
